ncrp.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
ncrp.note: File and track a complaint. You receive an acknowledgement number — quote it when escalating to platforms, banks, or police.

1930.name: 1930 Cyber Fraud Helpline
1930.note: Dedicated to financial fraud. Reporting here is what triggers bank-level action to freeze a transfer.

certin.name: CERT-In
certin.note: India's national incident response agency. Relevant for account compromise, phishing infrastructure, and platform-level incidents.

stopncii.name: StopNCII.org
stopncii.note: Generates a hash of your image on your own device. Participating platforms check uploads against it. Your image is never uploaded.

takeitdown.name: Take It Down (NCMEC)
takeitdown.note: For people under 18, or a parent or guardian acting for them. Hash-based, same principle as StopNCII. Not available for adults.

cybercrime-women.name: NCRP — Women and Child section
cybercrime-women.note: The dedicated intake form on NCRP for intimate image abuse, stalking, and offences against women and children.

112.name: Emergency Response Support System
112.note: India's single emergency number. Use this when there is an immediate risk to someone's safety, not for reporting after the fact.
